name: ojg-structured-value-path-diagnostics
instr:
ojg cannot report structured locations for failures during recursive value processing. Add opt-in diagnostics shared by checked conversion, decomposition, alteration, compact JSON and SEN, and pretty JSON and SEN without changing successful or non-diagnostic behavior.

A `DiagnosticError` identifies the active `Operation`, exposes an immutable caller-owned `ValuePath`, includes both in stable error text, preserves the exact cause through `Unwrap` and standard Go error inspection, and reports structural locations consistently. `ValuePath` holds root-to-leaf `PathElement` values whose `Kind` is `PathKey`, `PathIndex`, or `PathField`. Render it deterministically using externally encoded field names.

Every recursive failure must include its complete root-relative location, with equivalent typed elements across processors for reflected fields, map keys, indexes, callbacks, custom marshalers, and custom simplifier boundaries. Do not add synthetic custom-value boundary elements.

Define `Operation` from zero as `OperationConvert`, `OperationDecompose`, `OperationAlter`, `OperationJSON`, `OperationSEN`, `OperationPrettyJSON`, `OperationPrettySEN`, and `OperationWrite`. Define `DiagnosticMode` as `DiagnosticsDisabled`, then `DiagnosticsEnabled`. Enable diagnostics explicitly through shared `Options`.
